summary:
Plan of w129 (requests#r13, #r14) written to plan.md.
Both scenarios are red because no steps bind requests.feature; under that, work show reads only work-items and work status reads no observations.
D1: status with no initiative adds the uncited observations after the initiative blocks. Requests r14 and work-queue r17 are both in force, so replacing the blocks is not allowed.
D2: --json gains requests and observations keys; the existing keys are unchanged (0058).
D3: open_text (the SessionStart hook) stays per initiative (migration-tools r32), so migrate_session.py is unchanged.
D4: a request or observations file that is not UTF-8 makes the command refuse, naming the file (work-queue r7, 0058).
D5: an observation is cited by the source of any initiative or any request, by its full or short id.
model_work.py is left to w131; CLAUDE.md is unchanged; the steps go in a new requests_show_steps.py.
No existing test breaks (status, hook and show steps checked).
